description: For one product, list the retailers that currently have it in stock, with price, configuration (blade steel, color, finish), when Drop Beacon last checked, any coupon, and a tracked buy link. If a name matches several models, the reply says so and lists other_matches. Prices are observed by Drop Beacon and can change; the retailer page is authoritative at checkout.

product.description: An edc4me.com product URL (most precise), a product slug, or a product name such as "Spyderco UK Penknife Salt LC200N".
